title: Taste of Gastown Curated Evening Experience with Drinks
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the historic streets of Gastown on a culinary journey that elevates the traditional food tour into a refined dining experience. Over 3 hours, savor curated dishes paired with handcrafted cocktails and wine, all while being immersed in engaging storytelling that reveals the rich history of Vancouver's oldest neighborhood. This tour is perfect for date nights, celebrations, or corporate gatherings, Discover local hidden gems as you connect with fellow food lovers in a vibrant evening setting.
- Enjoy a curated selection of 3 local dishes and 4 alcoholic beverages
- Experience engaging local storytelling and Vancouver's history
- Dietary accommodations available (except gluten-free) with advance notice
